== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Ilidus of the Empty Palm]] ([[Boreas Seabed (explorable area)]], not during [[The Halcyon Job]])
* [[Senkai, Lord of the 1,000 Daggers Guild]] (Boreas Seabed (explorable area), only during The Halcyon Job)

== Notes ==
* Great synergy for [[Repeating Strike]] as the skill will not consume energy and can be easily spammed.
* This skill does not affect non-attack [[Off-hand attack#Skills which count as off-hand attacks|skills which count as off-hand attacks]].

== Trivia ==
* [[Xuekao, the Deceptive]] in [[Pongmei Valley]] used to have this elite skill, but it was switched out for [[Assassin's Promise]] in the [[Game updates/20060519|May 19, 2006 update]].
*The Japanese words for empty (kara) and palm (te) bring us the word "karate".
